Repealed. Pub. L. 89–44, title III, §304, June 21, 1965, 79 Stat. 148 ] Section 4286, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 510 , imposed a tax equivalent to 10 percent of the amount collected for the use of safety deposit boxes. Section 4287, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 510 , defined safety deposit box.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Pub. L. 89–44, title VII, §701(b)(4), June 21, 1965, 79 Stat. 157 , provided that: "The amendments made by section 304 [repealing these sections] shall apply with respect to use periods beginning on or after July 1, 1965."
